Setup
files.source:
✦ Your Glowcap app is ready


Scan with your phone's camera
or open this link on your phone
Android: it opens in Chrome → tap ⋮ → Install app (or Add to Home screen).
iPhone: open it in Safari → Share ⬆ → Add to Home Screen.
Xiaomi, Redmi or POCO? First allow Chrome to add icons: Settings → Apps → Chrome → Other permissions → Home screen shortcuts → Allow.
Use Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone). Some browsers, like Brave, block the app.
Keep this link private: it opens your own Glowcap. You can open this window again any time from the ✦ Glowcap menu. New features and fixes arrive in your app by themselves.

✦ Set up your phone app (one time, about 2 minutes)

1Open your app settings
Open the app settings ↗
A new tab opens.
2Click the blue Deploy button (top right) → New deployment.
3Click the ⚙ next to "Select type" → Web app.
4Check that Who has access says Anyone, then click Deploy.
5Google asks for permission: click Authorize access → choose your account → Advanced → Go to Glowcap (unsafe) → Allow.
"Unsafe" only means Google hasn't reviewed it. It's your own copy, and it only works with this sheet.
6Under Web app, click Copy.
7Come back to this sheet and choose ✦ Glowcap → Paste my app link. Paste it and click OK.
We check the link for you, then your QR code appears.
